title: Hybrid Dual-Batch and Cyclic Progressive Learning for Efficient Distributed Training of Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2509.26092v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distributed deep learning is critical for training convolutional neural network (CNN) models on large-scale image datasets with numerous parameters. Current research primarily focuses on leveraging additional hardware resources and powerful computing units to accelerate the training process. As a result, larger batch sizes are often employed to speed up training. However, training with large batch sizes can lead to lower accuracy due to poor generalization. To address this issue, we propose the dual-batch learning scheme, a distributed training method built on the parameter server framework. This approach maximizes training efficiency by utilizing the largest batch size that the hardware can support while incorporating a smaller batch size to enhance model generalization. translated_abstract: 分布式深度学习对于在具有大量参数的大规模图像数据集上训练卷积神经网络（CNN）模型至关重要。当前的研究主要侧重于利用额外的硬件资源和强大的计算单元来加速训练过程。因此，通常采用较大的批次大小来加快训练速度。然而，使用大批次进行训练可能由于泛化能力差而导致准确率下降。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了双批次学习方案，这是一种建立在参数服务器框架之上的分布式训练方法。该方法通过利用硬件所能支持的最大批次大小来最大化训练效率，同时引入较小的批次大小以增强模型的泛化能力。通过同时使用两种不同的批次大小，该方法能以极少的额外训练时间提升模型准确率。此外，为了减少时间开销……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于参数服务器框架的双批次学习方案，通过同时使用硬件支持的最大批次和较小批次进行训练，在保持高效的同时显著提升模型的泛化能力和准确率。
en_tdlr: A dual-batch learning scheme built on the parameter server framework that simultaneously uses the largest hardware-supported batch size and a smaller batch to improve model generalization and accuracy with minimal additional training time.
